notes: A zombie horde held off indefinitely is Survival, and the answers confirm endless waves rather than a scored round, which is the Horde Defense preset exactly. The word arena is answered by the shape rather than by a second genre: Survival words space-bounded as a contained arena that keeps the threat and the player in proximity, so Action adds nothing the preset does not already build and I left secondary empty. Nothing in the prompt requires a modifier, so it stays on P0. Deciding without a user: I left out gate-escape because an endless hold-out has no exit to reach, and read the horror answer as dark, foggy, rotting dressing on the same geometry rather than as a change of shape.
